name: Markdown
author: Martin Mitáš (md4c)
description: Render Markdown to HTML from the Terminal (CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown). Type md notes.md for HTML on stdout, md -f -o out.html notes.md for a full HTML document to a file, md --gfm for GitHub-flavored tables/strikethrough/task lists.

descriptions.en: Render Markdown to HTML from the Terminal (CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown). Type md notes.md for HTML on stdout, md -f -o out.html notes.md for a full HTML document to a file, md --gfm for GitHub-flavored tables/strikethrough/task lists.
descriptions.it: Converte Markdown in HTML dal Terminale (CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown). Scrivi md note.md per l'HTML su stdout, md -f -o out.html note.md per un documento HTML completo su file, md --gfm per tabelle/barrato/checklist stile GitHub.
